Class MuratRayTracer

java.lang.Object
net.murat.lovert.MuratRayTracer
public class MuratRayTracer extends Object

MuratRayTracer - Complete Ray Tracing Demo

Full demonstration of the ray tracing engine including all setup steps.

Core Engine Features

This ray tracing engine is fully redesigned to be 100% garbage-free during render() execution: every Point3/Vector3/Ray/Intersection instance that is needed during pixel tracing is pre-allocated once in the constructor and reused for every single pixel and every recursion depth.

  • Field Details

    • MAX_DEPTH

      public static final int MAX_DEPTH
      Maximum supported recursion depth for the pre-allocated stacks. This value is hard-coded to 8 to balance quality and performance. Higher values would require recompilation with larger arrays.
      See Also:
      • Constant Field Values

  • Constructor Details

    • MuratRayTracer

      public MuratRayTracer(Scene scene, int width, int height, int backgroundColor)
      Creates a new ray tracer bound to the given scene and output resolution. All scratch objects are pre-allocated here to ensure zero allocations during the render() method.
      Parameters:
      scene - the scene to render
      width - output image width in pixels
      height - output image height in pixels
      backgroundColor - packed ARGB color used wherever no geometry is hit

    • render

      public android.graphics.Bitmap render()
      Renders the bound scene and returns the resulting image. Uses stratified jittered supersampling (ssGrid x ssGrid per pixel) to eliminate aliasing/moire on high-frequency textures viewed through refractive/reflective curved geometry (e.g. checkerboard through a glass sphere). No allocation happens inside the per-pixel loop except the Bitmap itself, which is created once.
      Returns:
      the rendered Bitmap
